item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory No. 5 #SLPRSD
item.description:
Thunderstorm Advisory No. 5 #SLPRSD
Issued at 01:45 PM 15 September 2026

Moderate to heavy rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are expected over #OrientalMindoro(CityOfCalapan, Naujan), #NorthernSamar(Catarman, LopeDeVega, Mondragon, LasNavas and SilvinoLobos) within the next 1 to 2 hours.

The above conditions are being experienced in #Marinduque(Boac, Mogpog, Gasan, Buenavista), #Albay(CityOfLigao, Oas, PioDuran), #OrientalMindoro(Bulalacao, Mansalay, Roxas and Bongabong) which may persist within 1 to 2 hours and may affect nearby areas.

All are advised to take precautionary measures against the impacts associated with these hazards which include flash floods and landslides.

Keep monitoring for updates.
